title: Rasuwa District Profile
text:
The population of Rasuwa district is 23,430.
Of the 27 wards in Rasuwa district, 15 have been affected by the flooding, according to the NDRRMA.
With reference to the plot below, 20% (2,225) out of the 11,131 households in Rasuwa are in the poorest quintile nationally, in line with the average for Nepal. Of the affected wards, Gosaikunda-1 and Uttargaya-1 are of particular concern, given the particularly high percentages of their populations who are in the poorest quintile nationally.
As of the 2021 Census, there were 1,290 people with disabilities in the district, though it should be noted that this figure relies on self-reporting, so the actual number might be much higher.

title: Rasuwa District Profile
text:
Agency presence


Sector presence, however, tells a very different story from where beneficiary frequencies were reached. Somewhat commonsensically, agency presence is highest in Uttargaya, the most accessible part of the district. It should also be mentioned that Dhunche, the district seat and the location of the District Administration Office, is located in the lower reaches of Gosaikunda.
